title: deliverCarriedWork counts a carried head holding only a report commit as delivered work (finding 326c0028)
description: internal/reconcile/dispatch.go ~3449 deliverCarriedWork treats a carried head that holds only a RESULT report commit as delivered work. #260 keeps the fallback-report case away from it, but the code is unchanged: a try that carries only an earlier try's report can still be judged as delivering. Count only non-report commits as work.
acceptance_criteria: a carried head with only a report commit is not delivered work; reconcile test; PR CI green before merge; make gate
